about: VisionClaw's evaluation set (phase 5.1). Requests written fresh on 2026-11-18, in the casual words a blind person uses, and never used to tune VisionClaw: none is in tests/live_orchestrator.py, and the bank of known requests (claw/intents.py) must never take from here. Each has the jobs (planner.RECIPES) that count as right for each of its parts, in order. facts: where the user is, for the router. Score with: python tests/eval_routing.py MODELS
